findings: The 25-frame mask index contains exactly two plant masks per frame, matching the two physical foliage instances after 3D-anchor projection association.
Detector suffixes change during the sequence, so plant_01 and plant_02 filenames are not stable physical instance identifiers.
No pot, flowerpot, planter, or vase label occurs in any of the 25 frames.
The visible containers are not separate plant-category instances and are not part of the selected plant modal masks.
The 3D anchors reliably disambiguate the two foliage instances, but do not create independent segmentation evidence for the missing containers.
fail_closed_reasons: There is no hash-bound container mask to union with either foliage mask.
Cropping a nightstand or lamp mask around the container would relabel support or neighboring geometry without instance evidence.
Expanding the foliage mask by morphology or a bounding box would absorb tabletop and lamp pixels and is not an acceptable source condition.
required_next_step: Run a targeted source-frame segmentation pass for complete potted plant instances or explicitly segment and 3D-associate foliage and container parts before materializing a union condition.
scope: Local audit evidence only. No TRELLIS run, generated mask, clean plate, or production manifest mutation was performed.
